description: Update pinned GitHub Actions digests only. Flake inputs are already refreshed by the weekly flake-update workflow; automerge stays off so every dependency bump keeps a human review. This file takes effect once the Renovate GitHub App is installed and enabled for this repository; until then it is inert configuration.
commitBody: Renovate proposes only reviewed updates: the release and CI workflows pin actions by digest, and every Renovate PR still passes the full check workflow before merge.
